notablePrerequisites: You are able to pay to cast Ancestral Statue using any combination of mana-producing creatures and/or creatures that can reduce its cost using convoke.
description:
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying its mana cost reduced by the number of creatures you can tap while casting it.
When Ancestral Statue enters, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Ancestral Statue trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
